bibliographic.title: Hide and Seek
bibliographic.author: Puka Muriska
bibliographic.genre: Surreal, fantasy, dark, comedy, absurd, gore, liminal, imaginary world, dream, nightmare, horror, labyrinth,
bibliographic.description:
This is the interactive part of the Hide and Seek zine that can be read for free here (in Spanish and English). It's about playing Hide and Seek in my imaginary world, and playing around with (and sometimes, against) imaginary beings, with the cute little deck of magical cards the Prince (the kid you are playing hide and seek with) drew specially for this game as your only "weapon".

It's mostly oneiric landscapes descriptions inspired in my own dreamworld and obviously my imaginary world. There are some gore descriptions, but it's always in an absurd, dreamlike way. I wrote this thinking for an adult audience, but I think it's ok for kids older than 13 years old to play it (the zine is 100% safe for everyone).

Also, the game itself is alive, and you'll have to deal with her. Dying doesn't mean anything in the dreamworld, so keep that in mind before playing: being dead won't make you lose, the game will stop ONLY when you manage to find the Prince.

It can be played on Itch.io and it's also available in Spanish (this English version is a translation from the original in Spanish).
